description: For hvac installation, this issue tracking log records load basis, placement, clearances, connections, commissioning points, permits, training, and warranty registration. Its supporting evidence includes equipment data, pressure test, vacuum record, airflow and temperature readings, startup sheet, and installation photos.

subtitle: Hvac Installation Issue Tracking Log: HVAC equipment installation and startup using equipment model, load basis, and equipment data.
title: HVAC Installation Issue Tracking Log
use_case: Use the issue tracking log during HVAC equipment installation and startup when the hvac installation record must identify equipment model, capacity, refrigerant, duct or piping interfaces, controls, power, drain, and served zones. Complete the applicable handoff for commissioning acceptance, setpoints, owner training, warranty registration, permit closure, and service baseline.
